author: Inside Edition
description: There is outrage over the death of a mama bear who liked to take dips in neighborhood pools and build comfortable places for her cubs to rest. Freedom for the bear, lovingly known as "Blondie," abruptly came to an end after wildlife officials drove her out of a crawl space, tranquilized her and eventually euthanized her. The California Department of Fish and Wildlife captured Blondie after they say she swiped at a woman who was walking her dog and a man sitting on his porch.
title: Outrage After Wildlife Officials Euthanize Neighborhood Mama Bear

author: Inside Edition
description: Savannah Guthrie says she is wracked with guilt over the thought that her fame triggered her mother's abduction. Nancy Guthrie appeared on the "Today" show several times, most recently last November. Savannah fears those appearances may have made her a target. Heartbroken Savannah sobbed throughout her interview with Hoda Kotb. The 54-year-old "Today" show host also revealed new information about the kidnapping 54 days ago.
title: Savannah Guthrie Says She Fears Her Fame Led To Mother's Kidnapping

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman logged on to a virtual court hearing from her car while driving. After Judge Michael McNally, presiding in Woodhaven, Michigan, told her she can not be driving, the woman told the judge she was in the passenger seat. Kimberly Carroll told the judge that she would have her "driver" pull over, but the judge was not buying it. Judge McNally then asked to see the driver. Carroll looks like a deer caught in headlights.
title: Woman Caught Lying To Judge About Driving During Virtual Court Hearing

author: Inside Edition
description: Help has arrived in Cuba, and not a moment too soon. The United States blockade on energy has affected the island nation's water supply, with a lack of electricity disabling residents' ability to pump water into their homes. Humanitarian aid has been coming into the country, providing water and supplies, but Cubans have already been dealing with shortages for months. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Humanitarian Aid Arrives In Cuba After Blockade Causes Water Crisis

author: Inside Edition
description: A mom thought she was getting a cute video of an animal in the wild, little did she know she spotted a fugitive on the run. Simba the capybara is making the most of his freedom after escaping from a zoo in Hampshire, England. However, his sunbathing session was interrupted when a dog walker got a little too close and a witness said he jumped into the river. Since then, he has been a master at eluding capture. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Sightings Of Capybara That Escaped From Zoo Show Him Having A Great Time
